baseline.name: retained local64 exact IQ2 tile2 with current-P4 head/KV and wave-local SWA reducer

candidate.description: exact local32 reconstruction of the retained local64 IQ2 selected gate/up+SiLU tile2 body; one wave replays the original two wave32 K partitions sequentially and combines their totals in retained order

decision.action: reject and remove before runtime selection, trace, or complete-model/category gates
decision.reason: Sequentially replaying both retained wave32 K partitions removes LDS and the block barrier but loses their parallel execution. It regresses first/last actual IQ2 layer events by 5.08-5.15% and synchronized wall by 4.50-5.27% despite byte equality.
decision.next: retain the local64 tile2 body and screen a genuinely different exact device-work or dispatch contraction from the current 772-dispatch profile
